payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: A compact ResNet-style CNN with CIFAR-style 3x3 stride-1 stem (preserving 28x28 resolution), progressive channel expansion (64→128→256), and residual connections will effectively capture both local nuclear morphology and tissue-level texture in 28x28 histopathology patches. With ~2.8M parameters, it has sufficient capacity for 90k samples while fitting in limited GPU memory. Dataset-specific normalization and mild class weighting address the domain-specific color distribution and 1.63:1 imbalance. The residual architecture enables deeper feature hierarchies without vanishing gradients, and the global average pooling + dropout head provides regularization against overfitting on small patches.
